subject: general
question: The forms of oaths of office for a Minister for the Union in India is contained in the:
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Third Schedule.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Forms of Oaths or Affirmations for Ministers, Ministers of State, Members of Parliament, and Candidates and other important officeholders of the country are contained in the **Third Schedule. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are a total of twelve schedules in the Indian constitution that deals with different subjects as given below- 

 
 

 First Schedule
 States and union territories
 
 

 Second Schedule
 
 
Provision of

 
 
• the President, Governors of States,
 
• Speaker and the Deputy Speaker of the House of the People
 
• Chairman and the Deputy Chairman of the Council of States
 
• Speaker and the Deputy Speaker of the Legislative Assembly 
 
• Chairman and the Deputy Chairman of the Legislative Council of a State
 
• Judges of the Supreme Court and of the High Courts
 
• Comptroller and Auditor-General of India
 
 
 
 

 Fourth Schedule
 The allocation of seats in the Council of States.
 
 

 Fifth Schedule
 Administration and Control of Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes.
 
 

 Sixth Schedule
 Administration of Tribal Areas in the States of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram.
 
 

 Seventh Schedule
 Union list, State list, and the concurrent list.
 
 

 Eighth Schedule
 list of recognized languages. 
 
 

 Ninth Schedule
 validation of certain Acts and Regulations.
 
 

 Tenth Schedule
 disqualification on the ground of defection.
 
 

 Eleventh Schedule
 powers, authority, and responsibilities of Panchayats.
 
 

 Twelfth Schedule
 powers, authority, and responsibilities of Municipalities.
